title: State store retains unbounded data
summary: Client state stores accumulate records, histories, or cache entries without eviction.
rationale: Unbounded client-side state increases memory use and slows rendering over time.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Add cache eviction, normalize state, limit history, and clear route-specific state.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
